question: Can the original oriented scalar seam kernel select a charged CAR polarization and its time response without a target covariance?
summary_de: Ein echter skalarer 2D-DtN und die Randorientierung rekonstruieren die holomorphe Randalgebra durch ker(Lambda+i d_s), Weyl-invariant. Der originale additive v210-Operator besitzt diesen Kern nicht. Der Spinlift des geladenen P1-Feldes samt Ladungsverbindung und gleichraeumigem Transfer bleibt vor einer physischen CAR-Zustandsableitung zu identifizieren.
claim_scope: Scalar CR reconstruction, original source applicability, and conditional spin/CAR bridge only; original clock and Clifford identities preserved
resolved: Orientation plus genuine scalar DtN reconstructs holomorphic boundary algebra
Oriented scalar CR kernel is invariant under interior and boundary Weyl rescaling as a smooth-function subspace
Actual positive additive v210 ansatz has zero CR kernel and fails the constant-mode scalar DtN identity
Periodic selfdual CAR requires a zero-sector covariance; untwisted bounding spinors avoid that zero mode
Original v506 NS and R matrices have equal geometric permutations but opposite lift squares
Explicit conditional free NS two-point kernel once field and same-space generator are given
kills: The literal positive additive v210 operator is a massless scalar Laplace DtN
Scalar periodic Hardy projector is already a selfdual Majorana covariance
Geometric free deck permutation alone forces its NS fermion lift
Clifford implementation creates U^2=fermion parity from an ordinary O^2=I Majorana action
not_derived: Actual charged P1 field as a section of the induced bounding spin bundle and charge bundle
Charge connection, field multiplication and CAR-conjugation identification
Original transfer as the same-space free or interacting charged generator
Full spectral convergence of the moving v210 median projectors
E8 charged extension and physical theory completion
assumptions: CR reconstruction requires genuine potential-free scalar DtN on smooth oriented surface with connected boundary
NS uniqueness statement uses a specified free untwisted spin Dirac and quasifree ground-state prescription
No identification of internal Spin16 with spatial or Lorentz spin is assumed
Moving-edge identities are local compressions; spectral-limit claims remain conditional
